outcome: encephalomyopathic mtDNA depletion syndrome 13 (MTDPS13) clinical phenotype
cohort: The study describes a 4.5-year-old boy diagnosed with MTDPS13 due to a novel homozygous FBXL4 variant.
finding: This report identified a novel pathogenic FBXL4 variant associated with a milder clinical phenotype of MTDPS13 than typically reported.
